high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the account "indianstartupnews." The post features two individuals sitting in front of a backdrop with the logo of Razorpay, a popular payment gateway company in India. The individuals appear to be smiling and are dressed in business casual attire. The text overlay on the image reads: "India's Razorpay is in talks with large global funds to raise 250 million at a valuation of around $4 billion.
